factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Indicators table: Equity ratio 2025: 62.8%, 2024: 56.9%. Debt ratio 2025: 8.0%, 2024: 7.5%.

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents declined to EUR 41.4 million from EUR 91.9 million, primarily due to dividend payments of EUR 33.6 million and increased inventory investments for real estate development.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: Cash and cash equivalents 2025: 41,424 thousand EUR, 2024: 91,879 thousand EUR. Note 13: Dividends paid in 2025: 33,630 thousand EUR. Note 18: Inventories increased from 196,521 thousand EUR in 2024 to 219,812 thousand EUR in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: The group’s secured order book grew significantly to EUR 466.9 million from EUR 340.6 million, indicating a robust pipeline for future revenue recognition, particularly from new contracts signed in the second half of 2025 and early 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 3: 'As of 31 December 2025, the group’s secured order book stood at EUR 466,867 thousand (2024: EUR 340,589 thousand)... According to management estimation, 47% of revenue is going to be recognised in 2026 and 53% in 2027 and beyond.'

factual_claims.claim: Key business developments included the successful completion of major projects such as the Rail Baltica Ülemiste terminal and various wind farm infrastructures.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Largest Construction Contracts Signed in 2025 table: Includes 'Construction contract for the Rail Baltica Ülemiste international passenger terminal / Tallinn, Estonia' valued at 85.0 million EUR. Management Report also references wind farm infrastructure projects in Lithuania and Latvia.

factual_claims.claim: The group also secured its largest contracts in history for the Rūdninkai defense campus in Lithuania, which will contribute to revenue starting in 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of the Chairman of the Management Board: 'the second half of 2025 showed a clear improvement, and preparatory efforts resulted in new major contracts... the most extensive and thorough preparation was carried out by our Lithuanian colleagues and in the first days of the current year resulted in the signing of the largest contracts in Merko’s history for the construction of two phases of the Rūdninkai defence campus... these contracts will begin to contribute to revenue gradually in 2026 and onwards.'

factual_claims.claim: Management highlighted that while global uncertainty and high interest rates restrained private investment, public sector demand in defense and infrastructure provided stability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of the Chairman of the Management Board: 'High global turbulence continues to restrain investments, particularly private investments... At present, most major investments are made mainly by the public sector, largely in defence and infrastructure... Investments in the energy sector, especially in renewable energy, have declined compared to the previous period.' Also, Management Report discusses public sector focus on defense and infrastructure.

factual_claims.claim: The company fulfilled its long-term financial objectives, achieving a return on equity of 15.6% and maintaining an equity ratio above the 50% target.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Indicators table: Return on equity 2025: 15.6%. Equity ratio 2025: 62.8% (above 50% target mentioned in Financial Objectives section).

factual_claims.claim: The Management Board proposed a dividend of EUR 1.25 per share for 2025, payable from retained earnings, reflecting a commitment to shareholder returns despite the cyclical downturn in construction volumes.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Profit Allocation Proposal: 'The Management Board proposes profit allocation as follows: Dividends (EUR 1.25 per share) 22,125,000'... Retained earnings after profit allocation: 229,740,359'. Also, Note 13 states: 'In cooperation with the Supervisory Board, the Management Board proposes to pay the shareholders EUR 22,125 thousand as dividends from net profits brought forward (EUR 1.25 per share) in 2025.'

numerical_claims.claim: Consolidated revenue decreased by 42.3% to EUR 310.9 million from EUR 539.0 million in 2024.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 42.3% decrease to EUR 310.9 million from EUR 539.0 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Revenue 2025: 310,941 thousand EUR (310.941 million), 2024: 539,049 thousand EUR (539.049 million). Calculated decrease: (539,049 - 310,941)/539,049 = 42.3%.

numerical_claims.claim: This drop was largely attributable to a 68.8% reduction in revenue from Lithuania, where major defense and renewable energy contracts concluded, and a 24.0% decrease in Estonia.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Lithuania revenue 2025: 88,608 thousand EUR (vs 283,613 thousand EUR in 2024) = 68.8% decrease. Estonia revenue 2025: 170,771 thousand EUR (vs 224,655 thousand EUR in 2024) = 24.0% decrease.

numerical_claims.claim: Conversely, revenue in Latvia increased by 68.9%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Latvia revenue 2025: 51,562 thousand EUR (vs 30,536 thousand EUR in 2024) = 68.9% increase.

numerical_claims.claim: The construction services segment, which accounted for 76.4% of total revenue, saw its sales drop by 49.9% to EUR 237.6 million, while real estate development revenue rose slightly by 13.8% to EUR 73.4 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Construction service revenue 2025: 237,568 thousand EUR (76.4% of total), 2024: 474,557 thousand EUR. Decrease: (474,557 - 237,568)/474,557 = 49.9%. Real estate development revenue 2025: 73,373 thousand EUR, 2024: 64,492 thousand EUR. Increase: (73,373 - 64,492)/64,492 = 13.8%.

numerical_claims.claim: Gross profit fell to EUR 55.9 million from EUR 95.9 million, though the gross margin remained stable at 18.0% compared to 17.8% in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Operating profit decreased substantially to EUR 34.3 million from EUR 72.5 million, resulting in an operating profit margin of 11.0%, down from 13.4%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Operating profit 2025: 34,343 thousand EUR (34.343 million), 2024: 72,483 thousand EUR (72.483 million). Operating profit margin 2025: 34,343/310,941 = 11.0%, 2024: 72,483/539,049 = 13.4%.

numerical_claims.claim: Net profit attributable to equity holders of the parent was EUR 39.9 million, a 38.3% decline from EUR 64.7 million in the previous year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Net profit attributable to equity holders of the parent 2025: 39,918 thousand EUR (39.918 million), 2024: 64,668 thousand EUR (64.668 million). Decline: (64,668 - 39,918)/64,668 = 38.3%.

numerical_claims.claim: The net margin improved slightly to 12.8% from 12.0%, supported by lower general and administrative expenses and reduced finance costs.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Net margin 2025: 39,918/310,941 = 12.8%, 2024: 64,668/539,049 = 12.0%. General and administrative expenses decreased from 21,908 thousand EUR in 2024 to 17,478 thousand EUR in 2025. Finance costs decreased from 2,950 thousand EUR in 2024 to 1,164 thousand EUR in 2025.

numerical_claims.claim: EBITDA dropped to EUR 37.5 million from EUR 75.7 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EBITDA 2025: 37,500 thousand EUR (37.5 million), 2024: 75,700 thousand EUR (75.7 million).

numerical_claims.claim: Total assets decreased to EUR 415.1 million from EUR 447.1 million, while equity increased to EUR 260.6 million from EUR 254.3 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Total assets 2025: 415,036 thousand EUR (415.036 million), 2024: 447,095 thousand EUR (447.095 million). Equity attributable to equity holders of the parent 2025: 260,566 thousand EUR (260.566 million), 2024: 254,258 thousand EUR (254.258 million).
